# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** 13  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and aspiring teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c38 P29](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0029), [v1 c38 P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Lucinda  <sub>[v1 c3 P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019), [v1 c17 P33](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0033)</sub>; Seraphine  <sub>[v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell is a slender, strange-appearing girl with bright red hair that eventually darkens into a lovely auburn shade. She has noticeable freckles on her face, large expressive eyes, and a small pointed chin. She grows taller over time, carrying her head erect with a lively and romantic flair.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c10 P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043), [v1 c11 P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 c15 P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

## Personality

Nell is an intensely imaginative, sensitive, and romantic girl who experiences both deep joy and sorrow with great passion. She possesses a quick, fierce temper—especially when teased about her hair—and has a tendency to harbor strong grudges, though she ultimately forgives when she realizes her mistakes. Highly driven, stubborn, and academically talented, she holds herself to strong standards of duty, honesty, and affection for those close to her.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), [v1 c9 P39](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0039), [v1 c10 P32](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0032), [v1 c10 P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043), [v1 c15 P36](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0036), [v1 c15 P82](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0082), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v1 c38 P8](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0008)_

## History

Born in Nova Scotia to Edmund and Bertha Harcourt, Nell spent part of her early childhood in an asylum before being taken in by Thirza Abernethy and Obed at Grey Shutters. Though initially taken by mistake instead of a boy, she quickly bonded with Obed and Thirza despite several humorous clashes over her vibrant imagination, wild temper, and impulsive antics. On her first day of school in Brierley, she reacted furiously when classmate Hugh Carrow pulled her hair and called her 'Carrots,' smashing her slate over his head and initiating a bitter five-year feud and academic rivalry. Over the years, Nell formed a deep friendship with Isolde Pembroke, earned top marks in school, and excelled in dramatic recitations. After attempting to dye her hair black and accidentally turning it green, she was forced to cut it off, though it later grew back into a dark auburn. After completing school at Brierley, she attended the Academy at Regent's, where she won the prestigious Avery scholarship. However, upon discovering Thirza's failing eyesight and financial hardship, Nell selflessly gave up her university plans to stay home, taking up a teaching position in Brierley and finally reconciling with Hugh Carrow.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c12 P15](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0015), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P33](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0033), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032), [v1 c38 P8](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0008), [v1 c38 P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036), [v1 c38 P58](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0058), [v1 c38 P60](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0060)_
